NFL DFS Defense Rankings: Week 12 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Sunday, November 29 · 9 games · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 27, 9:32 PM ET

The Jaguars are the top-projected defense on the Week 12 DraftKings main slate at 7.7 DraftKings points for $4,000, against Tennessee. Patriots (7.5, $2,700) and Commanders (7.2, $3,200) are next.

The Patriots return the most per dollar among defenses projected for at least 6 points: 2.77 projected points per $1,000 at $2,700.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 27, 9:32 PM ET run of the Splash Play NFL model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are published.

Defenses to know in Week 12

Jaguars, JAX vs TEN ($4,000)

Jaguars carries the highest SPAGS model projection at the position, 7.7 DraftKings points at $4,000. That is 0.3 points clear of Patriots. The salary works out to 1.94 projected points per $1,000, 8th of 10 at the position. Across 50,000 simulations Jaguars averaged 7.8 points with a simulated floor of -0.1 and a ceiling of 15.9, and it holds 1% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. Jacksonville is a 14-point favorite at home against Tennessee, with an implied team total of 31.25 in a game totaled at 48.5.

Value: Patriots, NE at LAC ($2,700)

Patriots projects for 7.5 DraftKings points at $2,700, which works out to 2.77 points per $1,000 of salary. That is the best rate of any player priced in the cheaper half of the 10 defenses the model projects for 6 or more points. Across 50,000 simulations Patriots averaged 7.6 points with a simulated floor of -0.1 and a ceiling of 16.1, and it holds 17% of the simulated winning-lineup credit. New England is a 3-point favorite on the road against the Chargers, with an implied team total of 18.75 in a game totaled at 34.5.
